say: The course uses four accessories: ankara bags, fabric earrings, headbands and beaded bracelets.
Cut from the same fabric, they sell as a set. A customer who came for earrings may leave with a matching headband.

cards.d: Bag, earrings and headband from the same fabric. She came for earrings and leaves with a headband.
Offcuts from a tote bag are the right size for a headband, earrings and covered buttons.
Repeat the same few designs. You get faster, and consistent quality makes customers come back.

say: You waste less too. Tote bag offcuts become headbands, and small scraps become earrings.

say: Accessory making uses heat, blades, glue and tiny parts. Rest irons and glue guns on a stand, never on fabric, and unplug them when you leave the table.

cards.d: Rest irons and glue guns on a stand, never on fabric. Unplug them when you leave the table.
Cut away from your body. Keep blades and needles boxed. Use strong glues only with good air flow.
Beads and jump rings can choke young children. Work out of reach and sweep after each session.

say: Cut away from your body, and keep blades and needles in a closed box. Use strong glues only with good air flow, away from flames.

say: Beads, buttons and jump rings are choking hazards for young children. Work out of their reach, sweep after each session, and never sell beaded jewellery as a toy.

say: Production capacity is how many pieces you can make in a week at normal quality, with real life included: children, work and power cuts.

panel.heading: Work out your weekly capacity
items: Make three pieces and time each one
Find the average time per piece
Count your honest weekly hours
Divide weekly minutes by time per piece
Take away about one fifth

panel.rule: Promise from a timed trial, not from hope.

say: For example, Halima in Kano timed three pairs of covered-button earrings: 28, 22 and 20 minutes.

panel.heading: Halima's earrings capacity
items: Times: 28, 22 and 20 minutes
Ignore the first: average 21 minutes
6 hours for earrings: 360 minutes
360 ÷ 21 = about 17 pairs
Remove one fifth: about 13 pairs

say: She ignored the slow first pair, so her average is 21 minutes.

say: For a bulk order, divide the quantity by your weekly capacity, add a few days, and give that date. Ask a deposit, commonly half, and write everything in one WhatsApp message.

panel.heading: Big orders: the honest way
left: Give a date from your capacity
Put the order in one WhatsApp message
Later date, simpler design or a helper
right: Accept what you cannot finish on time

say: The common mistake is saying yes to avoid saying no. One late wedding order can cost you many future referrals.

say: To remember. Make a few repeatable items for one clear customer, cut from one fabric.
Describe your buyer. Keep heat tools on stands and small parts away from children.
And measure capacity with a timed trial, minus one fifth.

panel.heading: Remember
items: A product line is a few repeatable items for one customer
Matching pieces from one fabric make sets and use offcuts
Describe your buyer: age, style, budget, shops, reason
Heat tools on stands; small parts away from children
Capacity comes from a timed trial, minus one fifth

say: Now write your product line card, price your materials list, photograph your tidy workspace, and time three pieces to find your capacity.
